name: Hainan Airport Infrastructure Co., Ltd
summary: Hainan Airport Infrastructure Co., Ltd engages in the airport management business in China. The company is involved in aeronautical airport management, including take-off and landing, parking, passenger bridge, and passenger and security checks, as well as non-aeronautical airport management comprising ground services, duty-free commerce, taxable commerce, advertising, cargo, office leasing, and check-in counter rentals. It also engages in the management and operation of commercial real estate properties; ownership and management of hotels; catering services; asset management; and property management.
